route.cmd: TTB=$(ls -d /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/ttbatch/26f14af32 /home/ubuntu/closure-loop-local/ttbatch/26f14af32 2>/dev/null | head -1) && export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 $TTB/tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; SDCM=physical/s81_ph_views/common/io_vclk_m_${CK_SS_MEAN}.sdc SRC={SRC} OUT={RUN}/routes CORES=4 NEED=16 SRCS='rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_afifo.sv' CLK=cks SDCX=physical/s81_ph_views/ctrl/ctrl_ctr_tile.sdc POSTCTS=physical/s81_ph_views/ctrl/post_cts_vclk2.tcl bash physical/s81_ph_views/common/route_view.sh {NAME}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} contract dsfd_ctrl_ctr rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl/dsfd_ctrl_ctr.sv $CL_STOP_AFTER

budget.reason: S81-PH tile sheet is grade 'target' (no calibration: 467-900 ps); the tiles' measured insertion is far lower (svc_pc 145 ps, ctrl_ctr 61 ps at calibrate), so the sheet SDC would put vclk ~300+ ps late (output hold model -> mass hold buffering).
